summary: Build practical control over wind projects with schedules, risks, contracts, and reporting. Enroll in advanced training today.
lede: Wind energy project management coordinates project delivery from site development through commissioning. For professionals in wind, renewable energy, or project delivery, this course supports practical control of scope, schedule, cost, and stakeholder coordination. Learners build lifecycle plans and baseline schedules, assess site and delivery risks, manage procurement interfaces, and prepare commissioning and handover controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in wind, renewable energy, or project delivery and need sharper control over scope, risk, cost, and stakeholder alignment.
prerequisites: Participants should bring working knowledge of wind energy project lifecycles, project scheduling, and basic commercial or technical project documents. Familiarity with project controls terminology, contract interfaces, and general renewable energy development concepts will help you move quickly into applied exercises; no coding is required. The course treats advanced topics such as digital monitoring and AI-assisted forecasting at operational application level, not engineering-deployment level.
